purpose: Mechanically audited static contract for the normal runtime loader that fills DS:6D8A records consumed by the 5937 dispatch path.

source.independent_projects: project-a and project-b decompilation/listing/data outputs matched

contract.name: load_dispatch_record_39ED
contract.calling_convention: near body ending RET 0x4 at 3BAB; established BP frame; relocated 3A0A call passes the selector/descriptor word to far 05A0
contract.inputs_outputs: The entry gate at 39ED returns a byte used by OR/JZ: a nonzero result exits through 3BAA, while zero enters the loader body. The body reads a selector/descriptor word using DS:97E2, obtains a DS:6D8A record index from 05A0, reads two-byte fields at record +0x08/+0x0A/+0x00/+0x02, loads a size at +0x28 and resource B at +0x20/+0x22, loads a size at +0x0C and resource A at +0x10/+0x12, derives callback words +0x18/+0x1A from resource A, and jumps back to 39ED at 3BA7.
contract.scheduler_position: Normal resource-record construction before 5937/386F/0442 consumes the selected record; not a player callback scheduler pass
contract.object_effects: Allocates/fills runtime resource buffers and publishes far callback words in the record; 05A0 may reclaim the selector's old record first
contract.feeds_back_into_simulation: indirectly; 0442/0598 later consumes the runtime callback words, but no direct player simulation write is present

callees.name: manage_dispatch_record_selector_05A0
callees.flags: selector word; returns selected record index

callees.name: address_named_resource_loader_helpers
callees.flags: runtime sizes, buffers, and callback segment/selector

callers.name: address_named_dispatch_record_loader_callsite
callers.flags: far call to 01F7:05A0 occurs inside this loader body
